title: Carrick waits on Manchester United's verdict after a Monaco summit
summary: Manchester United's ownership and executives were due to settle Michael Carrick's future at a meeting in Monaco on 11 November, with chief executive Omar Berrada and football director Jason Wilcox reported to be leaning towards a change of head coach. United sit in the Premier League relegation zone with one win and eight points from ten games after a 4-4 home draw with Aston Villa, their worst start in four decades. Mauricio Pochettino is reported to be open to taking the job.
